newsitem.title: GERMANY: GOLF-BALLESTEROS MISSES CUT AND WILL TAKE NEXT WEEK OFF.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-BALLESTEROS MISSES CUT AND WILL TAKE NEXT WEEK OFF.

text.p: Ryder Cup captain Severiano Ballesteros missed the cut in the European Tournament Players Championship on Friday then announced he was taking next week off.
The Spaniard, who missed the PGA championship at Wentworth because of his recurring back problem, will be absent from the European grand prix in England.
Briton Van Phillips shot a four-under-68 to take the early second round lead with 139.
Ballesteros double-bogeyed the last hole by going into water, his second double of the round.
He also lost a ball just before the turn to finish with 79 and a 12-over 156.
"After losing the ball there was no motivation left for me," he said. "It's very clear. I will not be playing next week. My back is not too bad but I have no confidence.
"I haven't been able to play and then I've missed cuts, so everything has worked against me. The rhythm is not there, the concentration is just not there either and nor is my competitive instinct."

Ballesteros did not make it clear how long he is prepared to take off from the tour but he will seek no further help from the Munich doctor who has treated his compatriot Jose Maria Olazabal so successfully.
"I don't know my schedule but there is going to be no more treatment from the doctor in Munich," he said.
"This guy doesn't help my condition. I'm very happy for Jose Maria but he is no help to me."
It was Ballesteros's seventh missed cut in nine European Tour starts. He also missed the cut in the U.S. Masters and has not qualified for the U.S. Open in a fortnight's time.
